user.title: Set up Name Curator
user.description: Name Curator removes a device's room from its displayed name once the device is assigned to that area, so grouped dashboards stop reading “Living Room › Living Room Lights”. It can also keep entity ids in step when you rename a device — only that device's, never house-wide. Confirm to enable it.

init.title: Name Curator options
init.description: Saving reloads Name Curator and runs one pass with the new policy.

data.restore_on_move: Restore the full name when a device leaves its area
data.assist_aliases: Keep the old name as an Assist alias
data.rename_entity_ids: Follow a rename into entity ids
data.notify: Send a notification for every change

data_description.strip_devices: When a device's displayed name starts with its area's name (or an alias of it), set the device's user name to the remainder. The integration's own name is kept underneath.
data_description.strip_entities: Also shorten entities whose displayed name does not follow their device: explicit name overrides, and integrations that never adopted device-based naming.
data_description.restore_on_move: If a device that Name Curator shortened is moved out of that area, put its integration name back so it is not left as a bare “Vent Fan” with no room.
data_description.assist_aliases: For entities exposed to Assist, add the previous friendly name as an alias so voice commands keep working.
data_description.rename_entity_ids: When you rename or move a device, rewrite the entity ids that still spell out its old name, so `sensor.living_room_clock_time` becomes `sensor.living_room_wall_clock_time`. Ids keep the area prefix on purpose, and only the renamed device's entities are considered — an id is never changed on a guess. History and statistics follow; automations, scripts, scenes and dashboards are rewritten, and a rename is refused outright if the target id is taken or a reference cannot be rewritten.
data_description.excluded_device_classes: Entities with one of these device classes are left alone. Doors are excluded by default because they read as “Location Door”.
data_description.excluded_domains: Entities in these domains are left alone, ids included. Automations, scripts and scenes are excluded by default: their names are chosen deliberately and are not things in a room.
data_description.notify: Post a persistent notification listing exactly what was renamed.
data_description.debounce_seconds: Delay after a registry change before renaming, so a device being set up settles first.

curate.name: Curate names
curate.description: Run one full pass over every device and entity with an area, and post the result as a notification. Display names only; entity ids are never touched by a full pass.

dry_run.name: Dry run
dry_run.description: Only report what would change; write nothing.

curate_ids.name: Curate entity ids
curate_ids.description: Bring the entity ids of specific devices in line with their current name and area, for devices whose earlier rename never reached their ids. At least one device is required: id curation is deliberately never house-wide.

device_id.name: Devices
device_id.description: The devices to fix. Only these devices' entities are considered.

dry_run.name: Dry run
dry_run.description: Only report what would change; write nothing. On by default, because an id rename cannot be undone from the notification.

curate_ids_needs_target.message: Curate entity ids needs at least one device. Entity id curation is never house-wide: without a rename event to say what a device used to be called, the rule has to guess, and the prototype that guessed flagged {flagged} of {total} entities. Pick the devices you renamed.
